## Understanding error in climate and weather science

This project investigates the role of error in AI-driven modeling, with a focus
on climate and weather science. Project aims, methods, and a plain-language
overview will be added here.

## Join the conversation

We welcome expressions of interest from researchers working across disciplines.
AI is used in many areas of science, and we are especially interested in
perspectives beyond our current focus on climate and weather science.

[Get in touch](contact.qmd) to learn more or express interest.
